Jamba Juice Menu Prices

Jamba Juice has left its mark on the smoothie world for nearly three decades. While it initially made waves with its smoothies, this brand has since cranked up its menu game, serving breakfast, baked goods, and artisan bread to satisfy any craving. In a nod to the winds of change, they’ve even rebranded their name to simply ‘Jamba.’ But that’s not all; Jamba caters to the health-conscious crowd with a tempting array of plant-based and no-sugar-added options. With a menu as extensive as this, deciding what to kickstart your day with can be quite the problem. But fear not, for we’ve got the 2023 price lowdown right here, just for you!

FAQs about Jamba Juice

Which menu items have Jamba Juice discontinued?

While menu items whirl in and out to make room for fresh and exhilarating dishes, we can’t help but muse about the triumphant return of a cherished classic. So, let’s dive in and explore those dearly departed items at Jamba.

Kale-ribbean Breeze

was your green ticket to a whole serving of veggies in a mere 16 ounces. And let’s not forget, it tasted absolutely divine. Not only did it pack a punch in the flavor department, but it was also your go-to source for vitamins A and C while throwing in a decent dose of calcium and iron to keep you feeling invincible. As Jamba decided to shake up its menu, the Kale-ribbean Breeze had to make its grand exit. But don’t despair, for the memories of its nutritious goodness shall forever linger in the smoothie hall of fame.

Chili Mango

Chili in a smoothie might sound a bit peculiar, but hold that thought because the Chili Mango actually thrived during its time. It’s a medley of mango, passionfruit-mango juice, and a dash of chili lime, and that’s not all – there’s a fiber kick from chia seeds and a vitamin C burst from acerola. This smoothie was a rollercoaster of sweet and spicy flavors with a tropical twist that’ll make you shimmy and shake. 

Orange-A-Peel

This concoction was a whirlwind of flavors, featuring zesty orange juice, creamy frozen yogurt, succulent strawberries, and sweet bananas. It didn’t just stop at being tasty; it was a nutrition powerhouse. This smooth operator served a good dose of folate, thiamin, manganese, and iodine, making it a nutritious superstar. Orange you glad you had a chance to taste it while it lasted?

Pomegranate Pick-Me-Up

The Pomegranate Pick-Me-Up smoothie brought together a riot of flavors – blueberries, strawberries, pomegranate juice, a dollop of raspberry sherbet, and the ever-so-creamy Greek Yogurt. It was a blend that could rival the starriest of cosmic collisions. Additionally, this smoothie wasn’t just a pretty face. It was bursting at the seams with antioxidants, ready to protect your cells and take on the world, one sip at a time. 

Banana Berry

The bananas in this smoothie weren’t just chilling; they were hosting a full-blown fiesta. We’re talking bananas, blueberries, frozen yogurt, and raspberry sherbet, all coming together for a berry bonanza that defied the laws of fruit physics. So, if you ever had the pleasure of sipping on this flavor, you were sipping on pure smoothie royalty!

Summer Blackberry

This luscious creation graced the seasonal lineup with a charisma all its own. Featuring a blackberry pear juice blend that knew how to steal the spotlight, it paired up with a creamy oat milk frozen dessert and a dash of vanilla coconut milk for that extra touch of pizzazz. And, not to forget, the guest of honor, fresh pineapple, brought the tropical vibes that made this smoothie a legend of the season.

Chocolate Moo’d

The Chocolate Moo’d Smoothie was an irresistible fusion of nonfat vanilla frozen yogurt and a luxuriously creamy chocolate blend. It was pure indulgence, no doubt about it. However, it wasn’t the poster child for nutrition. Could this be the enigmatic reason for its discontinuation? It seems even the most delicious culprits can’t escape the long arm of the nutrition police!

Citrus Squeeze

This concoction was like a culinary matchmaker, bringing together strawberries, bananas, zesty orange juice, and sumptuous ice cream, all whipped into a flawless, compelling symphony of taste and texture. It was an ensemble of elements so harmonious it could make your taste buds break into applause. A fusion of fruity delight and creamy goodness, this shake was a masterclass in the art of perfection. But alas, as the winds of change swept through the menu, this Citrus Squeeze shake had to take its final bow. 

Matcha Lemon Squeeze

This morning miracle in a cup that once graced Jamba Juice’s limited breakfast lineup. It was a whirlwind romance between oat milk, zesty lime sherbet, tangy lemonade, guilt-free, fat-free vanilla frozen yogurt, matcha green tea, and the ever-exotic mango. But as limited-time love affairs often go, it had to bid farewell from the breakfast stage. 

Orange Carrot Karma

This smoothie held the promise of good vibes and pure delight for all lovers of the orange and carrot persuasion. It was a blend of banana brilliance, mango magnificence, carrot charisma, and the zesty zest of oranges. In addition, it was like a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day, a wholesome embrace of flavors that could make even the grumpiest of taste buds break into a grin. However, Jamba has tried to offer a substitute for this smoothie. But let’s be honest. It’s never going quite to match up.

Are there any discounts you can claim at Jamba Juice? 

Get ready to satisfy your cravings and unlock rewards with Jamba Rewards. It’s the ultimate ticket to snagging those exclusive deals and discounts. Your journey begins with a simple two-step process. First, click the Apple Store or Google Play Store, download the Jamba app, and sign up to create your account. Next, whether you’re headed to a nearby Jamba Juice location or ordering online, it’s time to claim your benefits. But what kind of rewards await? Let’s unveil the treasure trove of perks you can earn below.

50% OFF SMOOTHIE

Upon signing up for Jamba Rewards for the first time, customers can claim a generous 50% off Smoothie Reward, applicable for online and in-store orders. The rewards showcase themselves as a tempting list on the checkout screen for online orders. When opting for the classic in-store experience, customers need only request their chosen Reward to be redeemed by one of the helpful Jamba team members. A quick display of the rewards on their phone is all it takes to enjoy the benefits of their membership. Don’t miss out on this sweet deal!

50% OFF FOOD ITEM

Another fantastic perk for first-time Jamba Rewards sign-ups is a 50% discount on their second order. Yes, you read that correctly! The folks at Jamba Juice go above and beyond to demonstrate their love for loyal customers; this irresistible offer is the perfect example. The process for claiming this bountiful discount is a breeze, whether you prefer the convenience of ordering online from the comfort of your screen or the in-person experience at a Jamba Juice store. So go ahead and sign up; your next Jamba adventure awaits!

$1 = 1 POINT

Jamba Rewards boasts an enticing point system that keeps the benefits flowing. Customers earn 1 point for each dollar spent, except for gift card purchases. The math is simple: every 35 points equate to a delightful $3.00 discount and the best part? There’s no upper limit on the number of points one can amass – the sky’s the limit! Fret not for those rare moments when your trusty smartphone isn’t within reach. Hold that receipt like a golden ticket because you can input your purchase details later. The catch? Make sure to log your transaction within seven days from the receipt’s date to claim your hard-earned points. It’s all about reaping the rewards at Jamba!

BIRTHDAY REWARD

Jamba Juice has a particular way of turning your birthday into a memorable celebration! The party starts when you’re a part of the Jamba Rewards family. If your cumulative Jamba orders amount to a splendid $15 or more, you’re in for a special treat – a complimentary birthday smoothie reward. Here’s the key to unlocking this delicious surprise: when you sign up, be sure to input your birthdate. This way, when the big day arrives, you can savor the sweet sensation of a free birthday smoothie. So mark your calendars because Jamba Juice knows how to make your special day even more precious!

What are the most popular menu items at Jamba Juice?

Mango-a-Go-Go

Meet the Mango-A-Go-Go smoothie, the drink that practically jumps off the menu and beckons you to grab it by the straw. This crowd-pleaser is the brainchild of Passion-Mango juice, zesty Pineapple sherbet, and mango. But there’s more to this juicy tale. Not only is it a crowd-pleaser, but it’s also a vitamin-packed powerhouse, boasting an excellent source of Vitamin C and Vitamin A.

Strawberries Wild

This smoothie swiftly became a fan favorite, thanks to its enticing blend of strawberries, bananas, and frozen yogurt with a dash of apple juice. The juicy and plump strawberries, bursting with flavor, are the star of this drink. Packed with vitamins and antioxidants, they add a delicious sweetness and provide numerous health benefits. It’s the perfect drink for a hot summer day, a post-workout pick-me-up, or a sweet treat any time of the day.

Apple ‘n Greens

Have you ever witnessed the beauty of fruits and vegetables living in harmony? It’s a sight to behold! Imagine the sweet and tangy flavors of apples and strawberries blending perfectly with the earthy notes of kale. Add the juicy sweetness of peaches, mangos, and bananas, and you have the perfect combination of flavors in the Apple ‘n Greens blend. Not only does this blend taste delicious, but it also provides a wealth of nutrients that our bodies need. Vitamin B6 is essential for proper brain development and function, while copper helps to maintain healthy bones, joints, and connective tissues. Whether you follow a vegetarian, vegan, non-dairy, or non-gluten diet, this blend is perfect for you.

Pomegranate Paradise

This mouth-watering smoothie is made with a blend of fresh apple, juicy pear, and tangy pomegranate juice, which gives it a unique and delicious flavor that’s hard to resist. Not only is it deliciously smooth, but it’s also filled with chunks of sweet and juicy mangos, succulent strawberries, and ripe peaches. As a result, it became the go-to choice for customers seeking a refreshingly nutritious option. Essentially, a sip of this delightful creation was like taking a refreshing stroll through a fruit orchard on a sunny day – pure bliss in a cup!

Acai Super-Antioxidant

Jamba’s got a whole arsenal of antioxidant-packed drinks. But there’s one that reigns supreme, and it goes by Acai Super-Antioxidant. This purple elixir is a true cell-saver, packing a punch of strength and refreshment in every sip. It’s the dream team of blueberries, strawberries, acai juice, soy milk, and lime sherbet, ready to kick oxidative stress to the curb and leave your taste buds craving an encore.

Acai Primo Bowl

Jamba isn’t just the kingdom of smoothies; they’ve also raised the banner for delicious and nutritious meal options. The Acai Primo Bowl is one such heavyweight champion in their lineup, ready to tackle your hunger in style. This delectable bowl is a work of art, combining a vibrant medley of ripe strawberries, acai blend, and juicy blueberries, all gracefully floating in a sea of creamy soymilk. Additionally, sliced bananas join the mix, adding a tropical twist, while a generous sprinkling of organic granola brings a delightful crunch. Drizzled with honey and topped with a fluffy snowfall of shredded coconut, it’s like a picturesque island getaway right on your plate. With the Acai Primo Bowl, Jamba proves that wholesome meals can also be a feast for the senses.

Dragon Fruit Delight Bowl

Another one of the famous bowls at Jamba is the Dragon Fruit Delight Bowl. The key ingredients are refreshing pineapple juice, juicy pineapples, tropical mangos, sweet bananas, and succulent strawberries. These fruits come together in a harmonious, sweet, and tangy blend with a burst of tropical goodness that will transport you to a sunny beach paradise. But that’s not all – the Dragon Fruit Delight Bowl is also packed with wholesome goodness, thanks to its generous serving of organic granola. This crunchy mix of oats, nuts, and seeds provides a satisfying crunch and a dose of fiber and protein that will keep you full and energized for hours. To top it off, the Dragon Fruit Delight Bowl is garnished with a sprinkle of plump blueberries, a drizzle of honey, and a snowy dusting of shredded coconut. These finishing touches add a touch of sweetness and texture, making the bowl even more delightful and satisfying.

Is there a secret menu at Jamba Juice?

Jamba’s secret menu is like the best-kept smoothie treasure trove in town. They’ve been playing this game for as long as their fans can recall. Sure, some of these hidden gems might be shrouded in mystery for a reason, but why not venture into the unknown and see if you can unlock their flavor magic? Let’s go ahead and take a look at these mystery concoctions. 

Monthly Mystery Smoothie

Jamba knows how to keep the excitement levels high with their monthly smoothie flavor reveals– and no, you don’t have to be a secret agent to uncover these gems. In fact, all you need is a bit of social media savvy! Following Jamba on their social platforms will give you exclusive access to these limited-edition, off-menu wonders that leave casual smoothie enthusiasts in the dark. However, you won’t find these gems displayed prominently on the regular menu. Nope, they’re online-only, like the secret passage to flavor-town! October’s offering is the ‘Screamin’ Sour Lemonade,’ a refreshingly zesty delight just a few clicks away from your taste buds. So, follow, click, and sip your way into a world of flavor excitement.

Andre’s Surprise

Who is Andre? That’s a mystery for another day, but what we do know is that we owe this mysterious maestro a big thank you for conjuring up this fancy drink. This fruity frozen elixir can inject a jolt of energy into your most sluggish days. It includes a mix of  9 oz of orange juice and 1 oz of raspberry juice with two scoops of orange sherbet, one scoop of pineapple sherbet, one scoop of mangoes, and one scoop of peaches. Give it a try, and let the good times roll.

Berry Lime Sublime

This beauty is not just lip-smacking. It’s also a social media star, rocking a bright pink hue worthy of your Instagram feed. It’s packed with a powerful punch of 12 oz of raspberry juice, 9 oz of orange juice, two scoops of raspberry sherbet, and a scoop each of tantalizing raspberries and juicy strawberries. It’s a taste rollercoaster, with just the right balance of sweetness and a tart twist. Sip it, snap it, and savor the sublime!

Fruity Pebbles

This smoothie is a time machine to the playgrounds of your childhood. What’s in this blast from the past? A delightful mix of lime sherbet, raspberry sherbet, pineapple sherbet, orange sherbet, and soy milk. It’s a sip of sweet nostalgia, just like grandma’s cookies and Saturday morning cartoons.

Orange Whip

Are you craving an overdose of all things orange? Meet the Orange Whip – it’s a citrus symphony in a cup. This fearless concoction marries the zesty embrace of orange juice and the velvety charms of orange sherbet, all wrapped in a frosty hug of frozen yogurt. It’s like a citrus flavor explosion in your mouth, with each sip delivering a tangy punch that’ll have you puckering up for more.

Dirty Orgasm

The Dirty Orgasm might raise an eyebrow or two, but rest assured, the potential blush of saying it is a mere warm-up for the mind-blowing delight within! And if you’d rather not blush your way through the order, here’s a secret: just give your barista the top-secret ingredient rundown – 12 oz. peach juice, one scoop pineapple sherbet, one scoop orange sherbet, two scoops peaches, and one scoop strawberries. 

Hello Jesus

Known by some as the ‘Thank You, Jesus,’ this drink has a divine reputation for its heavenly taste. It’s a delightful fusion of a scoop of strawberries, a scoop of oranges, 4 oz of soy milk, and 6 oz peaches, with a touch of lime sherbet that not only adds a zesty kick but also gives it a radiant green hue. Sip it, and you might just find yourself offering a word of gratitude to the heavens above for such a taste sensation!

Peanut Butter and Jelly

If you’re hunting for the holy grail of secret menu items at Jamba Juice, look no further than the Peanut Butter and Jelly smoothie. It’s like a blast from your childhood lunchbox, cunningly disguised as a delightful drink. This secret recipe calls for 12 ounces of soy milk, a dynamic duo of two scoops of frozen yogurt, two scoops of strawberries, and a cheeky scoop of blueberries. Surprisingly, it tastes like the classic PB&J sandwich, even though the peanut butter is off vacation somewhere. It’s funny how flavors can play tricks on us.

Orchard Oasis

This drink whisk will take you away to the tranquil serenity of an orchard, all in the form of the Orchard Oasis. This fruity marvel is whipped up using 12 oz of peach juice, a scoop of pineapple sherbet, a scoop of blueberries, and a scoop of strawberries. It’s like having a Zen garden in a glass, minus the apple-picking chores and sunscreen application. 

Reese’s Pieces

Are you craving a divine duo of peanut butter and chocolate? The Reese’s Pieces smoothie is your ticket to flavor nirvana! Consider this your signature sip if Reese’s ranks are high on your candy chart. The exact recipe for this creamy concoction remains a well-guarded secret, making it all the more special. To unlock this flavor enigma, you only need to strut up to the counter and confidently ask for Reese’s Pieces by name. It’s the password to chocolate-peanut butter paradise.

Sour Patch Kids

If you’re hankering for a tongue-tingling treat, the Sour Patch Kids-inspired smoothie is your go-to for a tart and downright delectable sip. Simply request the following ingredients: 12 ounces of lemonade, one scoop of blueberries, and one scoop each of lime sherbet, pineapple sherbet, raspberry sherbet, and orange sherbet. It’s a tangy, zesty thrill ride – just like the candy that inspired it.

Apple Pie

This green dynamo is a tangy explosion of tart apple deliciousness, leaving your senses thinking it’s apple pie season. It’s as green as Kermit the Frog and tastes like a slice of apple pie in a frozen form. The recipe for this sweet mystery remains a well-guarded secret, making it the ultimate mystery in a glass. Just waltz up to the counter and confidently ask for the Apple Pie smoothie.

Berry Depressing

Ah, the Berry Depressing – the stuff of fruit-filled legends at Jamba! With a cast of vibrant berries that could outshine Broadway, this drink is like taking a bite out of the freshest bounty of nature. Bursting with an array of crisp, juicy berries, it’s the ultimate remedy for your daily fruit cravings. Now, it’s not one to spill the recipe secrets, but with a name like ‘Berry Depressing,’ you can bet those berries take center stage. Feel free to channel your inner Sherlock and ask the barista if they’ve got the scoop on this. 

Blue-Topia

As the name implies, the Blue-Topia is a true dream for blueberry lovers. This brilliant blue concoction isn’t just a feast for the eyes; it’s an antioxidant-packed delight that’ll have you radiating from the inside out. The top-secret recipe for this beauty? It’s a classified blend of 6 oz of blueberry juice, 6 oz of soy milk, one scoop of frozen yogurt, and one scoop of juicy blueberries. It’s like a blueberry paradise in a glass – a smoothie fit for the berry elite.

Peaches and Cream

Thanks to this brilliant smoothie rendition, you can indulge in the timeless delight of Peaches and Cream without the fuss. It’s all the flavor, none of the hassle. To get the authentic Peaches and Cream experience, ask for 6 oz of peach juice, 6 oz of soy milk, a velvety scoop of frozen yogurt, and a scoop of plump peaches. It’s like sipping a summer afternoon in a glass, complete with a delightful twist of whimsy. 

Pacific Passion

This drink is a one-way ticket to the West Coast. To get that sunny sensation, just stroll up to your friendly Jamba team member and spill the beans – you’ll want eight ounces of passionfruit-mango juice, a pair of pineapple sherbet scoops, two scoops of strawberries, and a scoop of peaches. It’s like a mini vacation in a cup, with a splash of surf, a hint of sunshine, and a lot of delicious adventure.

Are there any menu items for specialty diets? 

While Jamba offers a diverse menu that caters to various tastes, they’ve also rolled out a selection of nutritious options and embraced the plant-based smoothie trend. However, making wise choices depends on knowing the right factors to consider. Luckily, Jamba’s got a handy trick up its sleeve—customization. This feature can be a lifesaver, especially if you’re navigating dietary restrictions or aiming for a healthier path. So, without further ado, let’s delve into these more nutritious options to unlock a world of better choices.

Who is the target audience of Jamba Juice’s menu?

Jamba has honed in on a particular target market in the world of vibrant and health-conscious refreshments. Their ideal customers, typically between the ages of 16 to 30, exude youthful exuberance and a knack for creativity. These young and spirited individuals often find themselves in the middle-class bracket, driven by a desire to taste the freshness and feel the health benefits of their beverages.

For Jamba, the core objective is to reach out to this demographic. With a finger on the market’s pulse, they understand the importance of connecting with these young, creative souls who seek a tasty treat and a boost of essential vitamins with every sip. Their target customers are health-conscious individuals who value consuming balanced, nutritious meals that make them feel their best.

What’s interesting about Jamba Juice is that their appeal isn’t confined to one specific age group. While they primarily target the creative young middle class, their delicious and healthy offerings have a universal appeal, transcending generations. Everyone from teens to their parents can find a satisfying and nutrient-packed delight catering to their specific tastes and dietary preferences.

Jamba Juice thrives on being a part of the health-conscious revolution, where people of all ages come together to enjoy the benefits of fresh juice and feel-good, vitamin-rich nourishment. In a world where wellness and flavor blend seamlessly, Jamba Juice has carved a niche for itself, attracting a diverse yet like-minded community of individuals who understand that great taste and health can go hand in hand.
